fixtures.description: No recorded activities after history is complete; numeric zeros are not permission to render loading/incomplete history as inactivity.
Shuffled multi-year history: two tied sports on one day, record ties on different days, nullable and recorded-zero metrics, elapsed/moving differences, sparse periods and retained browsing dates.
Leap alignment, clamped year comparison, sparse all-year buckets, future exclusion and local today around time zone/DST boundaries.
Equal timestamps must use activity identity rather than API/input order; current-year records use only current-year activities even when their week starts in the prior year.
